description: This source file defines classes related to a no-operation checkpointer used within the Orleans streaming event hubs framework. It includes a factory class for creating checkpointer instances and a checkpointer class implementing an interface for checkpoint operations, mainly as placeholders that do not perform actual checkpointing.

classes.name: NoOpCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating singleton instances of NoOpCheckpointer used in testing scenarios where checkpointing retries or storage are not needed.

classes.name: NoOpCheckpointer
classes.description: A no-operation checkpoint class implementing IStreamQueueCheckpointer that always indicates the checkpoint exists and loads a fixed stream start marker, without performing any real state persistence.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a checkpointer instance for a given partition; in this case, always returns the singleton no-op checkpointer.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the checkpoint; here, it returns a predefined start of stream marker.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint with a new offset and timestamp; implemented as a no-op.
